items.title: Fire and explosion occur at Quaker Oats plant in Iowa
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, an apparent explosion caused a fire at a PepsiCo-owned Quaker Oats milling facility in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, though no injuries were reported.

items.title: CM Vantage and Alliant announce senior appointments
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, cM Vantage has appointed Amy Finnegan as managing director of casualty, while Alliant Insurance Services has added Karen Spangler as vice president.

items.title: European Commission unveils climate resilience framework and plans Climate Insurance Alliance
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, the European Commission has presented an EU Framework for Climate Resilience and proposed a Climate Insurance Alliance to address the natural catastrophe protection gap.

items.title: PHP security flaws highlight cyber risk aggregation and AI threats for insurers
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, recent vulnerabilities in the PHP programming language have raised concerns among ratings agencies regarding systemic cyber risks and the role of artificial intelligence in accelerating exploits.

items.title: Study finds marine life decline in Gulf of Mexico following 2010 oil spill
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, a study published in PNAS reports that marine animal populations in parts of the Gulf of Mexico declined significantly following the 2010 Deepwater Horizon oil spill.

items.title: Lockton appoints Sara Romine as Executive VP and Chief Legal Officer
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, insurance brokerage Lockton has named Sara Romine as Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary, succeeding Trey Humphrey.
